text: Robert's knowledge about cars is great. You can just leave the car and be rest assured that the car will be in good shape when you come to pick it up. He will answer all the questions you have. Little pricey but worth the buck.
It's been over 25 years of going to see Robert.  Moved from SF to EB and still taking my cars to Action Auto.
Robert is an excellent, honest mechanic. He isn't the cheapest around, but he won't push you into unnecessary work. …

The owner broke everything down. Did maintenance on my newly purchased used Altima. After doing a great job with the maintenance, he broke down for me how to properly maintain my car, and what was likely to happen next before my next maintenance. Just a perfect experience

Great work from these guys time after time. Been going to them for a few years and the work is consistent and solid. It’s really hard to find a mechanic that does good work and one you can trust but Robert is amazing.

I've been going to action for two years now. The service is efficient and well priced. They will call you if there's something needs to be done, but in general I don't ever feel like I'm being sold something I don't need. If they tell me work needs to be done (which has been rare), I trust their judgment and have it done.
Robert was great - showed me what was/wasn't wrong. Will be going to him as long as I can for everything car-related
By appointment only. I had a CVT fluid change done. Owner was honest and quoted me a fair price. Excellent service and on time. Will be coming back.
I trust my car mechanic to take good care of my car.  If you can't say that, you need to bring your vehicle to Robert at Action Auto.  Not fancy.  Just good car care.
Honest service with good prices. The owner always walks me through his repairs and stands behind his work. He's clearly in it for the long haul and isn't trying to make any quick bucks.

No one is more straightforward.
Honest, quality work.
Peace of mind is always priceless, but especially when it comes to repair and …

I can’t recommend this place enough. So incredibly kind and knowledgeable. Super honest too— definitely don’t live up to any mechanic stereotypes. I once misunderstood a price and when it was more than I thought, they reduced it to what I thought they had said.

These guys are awesome! My car broke down this morning in San Francisco, and I stopped into their shop unsure what to do. They assisted me and gave me recommendations for how to proceed. It was a huge help!
Robert is one of the most honest and efficient mechanics I have met. They can be hard to get an immediate appointment because they are so popular.
They always take good care of me. This time was no different. They gave me a very fair price and my car is running like a champ

Been going here for years and always get straight-up advice and high quality work. Robert and his team know what they’re doing and fully deserve their good reputation.
Great professional shop. Has done all the work on my 2010 Honda Accord and they have saved me money on more than one occasion.
Action Auto is the best! Robert is the most honest mechanic I've ever dealt with. I would recommend Action Auto to anyone.

A+++! Nolan and his team detailed a car for me today, and now it looks completely brand new. The interior hadn’t been cleaned for years, and he customized a package for me to make sure they could get it done without spending too much more. …

Albert and the entire WOW team were wonderful to work with. Albert was my point of contact and was very communicative and helpful. I took an older, 2011 Honda CRV for a silver package detail with seat shampooing and headlight restoration. …

Ethan and Lucas did an awesome job on my car. From the detailed wash to the ceramic coating I would definitely recommend them. They were friendly, informative, and very professional. All and all great experience.
recently had my vehicle treated with paint protection and ceramic coating at Cole’s Auto Detailing, and I couldn’t be more impressed with the results. …
Best mechanics in SF. I’ve been going for 3 years. They are fast, have great and affordable prices (and no upcharging), and are very flexible on scheduling. Such a nice family-run shop!

Family owned, personable and they do a good job with basic services, oil changes, shocks, tune ups etc. Make an appt ahead of time. Most recently went in for an oil change and they also noticed my tire has a puncture and fixed it (extra $30).

Extremely honest and efficient auto repair. I will definitely be coming back here. I think I paid less than what I was quoted too. I’m sure that doesn’t always happen but it was a nice surprise for me. I stopped by and showed them what …
There is not a better mechanic group in SF! They will start asap and finish asap. Mike's will not charge you unnecessarily. They give great advice and have earned my loyalty.

Great service, Ping, is wonderful. Check engine light went back on after replacing the PVC value and they inspected it again, cleaned inside, put the value back on and fixed the problem included in the original charge. Reasonable prices and convenient location for the inner sunset and Cole valley neighborhood.

helped fix a tire pressure sensor issue, fixed inflation on all 4 tires, and checked one of them  for nails. Whole experience took 10 minutes, didn’t try to upsell me on anything, offered to do it for $5.  Just great.

They are so great! Have had my car repaired multiple times there just this year - from a catalytic converter replacement, water pump fix & just today they patched my tire in less then 10 minutes. Amazing! Thank you!
Great, efficient, and cost effective service! So thankful to have found this tire shop! I was in and out in under 30 minutes to have my tire patched. Would highly recommend.

Great work from the mechanics here. Only complaint is that no one speaks English that well. Usually not an issue but I had a list of things I wanted addressed with my truck and only a few of them made it across the language barrier lol. …
The mechanic is top-notch, with highly precise diagnostics. I inquired about the cost of replacing the brake system, and the staff offered a very competitive price. I can’t wait to go back.

Trustworthy. My car broke down in the city and I took it to the closest mechanic. They easily could have taken advantage of me but they didn't. I ended up paying less than they quoted me and much less than I was expecting.

The people who run this shop are absolutely amazing!  Great service, timely manner, and easy on the checking account.  They have helped me in a pinch, and saved me from buying a lemon after I had them do a pre-purchase inspection.  If I could give them 10 stars, I would!

Friendly and fast! Popped in to get a headlight changed, they did it on the spot. Even noticed as I was leaving that one of my brake lights was also out and changed that really quick. I hadn't even noticed, so they saved me another trip! Thank you for your friendly family service!

I've used Mike's Union twice now and I have been extremely pleased with their service. They are very accurate with their cost and time estimates. I think they offer a good value for the money, and I will continue to go to them for service.
Fair, fast, skilled. They got my car in, diagnosed, and fixed it very quickly! Prices are fair and they are very friendly. Highly recommend!
